verdict.rationale: Turso documents a programmatic Platform API for managing databases, groups, organizations and tokens, so a machine-readable spec is a fair thing to ask for. However, no evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and a probe of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths on docs.turso.tech returned 404 on every one. The probe only covers likely paths, so a spec could exist elsewhere, which is why confidence is medium rather than high.
